title: How to Align Your Wheels on a Hill (Part 2)
hook: Part two! Never park on hills unprotected.

script.narration: Part two! Never park on hills unprotected.
script.visual_search: car parked on a steep hill street angle

script.narration: Turn your steering wheel completely toward the curb when facing downhill so the tires catch if brakes fail. When facing uphill with a curb, turn your wheels sharply away from the street.
script.visual_search: car front wheel turned against curb close up

script.narration: Always engage your parking brake first. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this trick? Comment yes or no. Because...

description: Part 2 of Dry Steering Explained! Learn how to properly align your tires when parking on a hill to keep your car safe if brakes ever fail. Essential parking tips for new and beginner drivers.
why_it_will_work: Fulfills the promised continuation of a popular series while answering high-intent search queries about parking safety.
